items.why: The report quotes a separate "2LA/E2g area ratio 9 vs 1.8", which implies it fitted the two modes separately, but it never says the 350–356 cm-1 band is two overlapping modes or gives their positions (about 351 and 355 cm-1).

It shows 2LA(M) much stronger at spot 1 ("2LA/E2g area ratio 9 vs 1.8"), but it uses E2g, not A1g, as the reference and never gives the 2LA/A1g ratio above 2 vs about 0.5 or calls it the monolayer fingerprint.

It reports "A1g 417.28 vs 420.08 cm-1", which matches the rubric numbers, but it only concludes "Spot 1 looks thinner" and says "monolayer status not established" instead of linking the shift to monolayer vs bulk.
The report never gives the A1g minus E2g1 separation for either spot.
It never says the position steps between 2L, 3L and bulk are only about 1 cm-1; "No layer count claimed" gives no physical reason.
It mentions Si only as a height indicator ("Si net height 1235 vs 118 counts"), not as a calibration check, and its only question is about PL, not the laser line or resonance.

wrong_claims.why: It never assigns the band maximum to E2g1 alone or builds a layer count on that position or separation; it states "No layer count claimed."
It never calls 2LA(M) a defect or impurity peak.
